events_seen: RATINGS SWITCH (Jul 20): Exchange adopts Dynasty Daddy contender grades (QB/RB/WR/TE/FLEX). All twelve stocks repriced: RDC +23.97%, FORG +12.24%, DEEP +10.39%, OBS -9.31%, MWB -7.51%.

TRADE (Jul 19): Corbishley receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Tee Higgins (WR, CIN), Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick. Fronge receives TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE), Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI), Nico Collins (WR, HOU), 2028 R2 pick.
TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: Filing now: the exchange has switched contender ratings agencies, effective immediately. Every board repriced this afternoon. I had this twenty minutes before it posted. Per source. Per me.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: To add context to my colleague's twenty minutes of glory: the move to Dynasty Daddy grades has been in the works since June — five inputs now, FLEX included. What was NOT planned is dropping it the day after the Dublin–Havana trade. One league official called the timing, quote, 'a choice.'

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: REDLINE UP TWENTY-FOUR PERCENT. I said sell in November. I said sell in May. I am saying BUY at $84.67 and I will not be taking questions about the journey.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Correction from last hour's promo: the Corbishley–Fronge trade closed yesterday, not four days ago — my producer and I have resolved our differences off-air. Frankly the story has moved anyway: twelve boards just repriced at once. Terrence and Dexter at the desk. Seven o'clock.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: ForgeHammer up 12.24% and suddenly everybody's a depth truther. I ranked that bench top-three in June while you were all doing Havana jokes. The screenshots have timestamps.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Obsidian fell 9.31% today and I will not let the agency take the blame. Let. Me. Be. Clear. You cannot rate your way around a QB11, RB12 operation. Brock Bowers is a monopoly asset trapped in a broken holding company, and tonight I intend to say so at length.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: New power rankings are live with the reprice. Kevin climbs three spots, which means I owe Detroit a formal correction — the hardest sentence I've written all offseason. Full list on the board.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: An agency that finally grades FLEX depth. Fronge first, Monarch eleventh. I have been yelling about benches into the void for a full calendar year and today the void yelled back.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Two trades, a new ratings agency, a FLEX column, and TWELVE repricings in one afternoon. I don't fully understand the methodology and I have honestly never been happier, FOLKS.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Last night I asked what happens when Monarch never moves. Today the new agency answered: minus 7.5% for standing still. I want my segment and I want it before that WR bank becomes a museum exhibit.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: The FLEX grade is a psyop. Naming a fifth starter category just rewards hoarding mediocrity. True contenders start four players and dare you to notice. Obsidian understands this. The market will catch up in 2029.
